title: Room 1.2 · Goblin Warrior (CR 1/4) · Moderate, 50 XP · bypassed: it fled on 1 HP
headline: The goblin cost him 8 HP and Magic Missile, then ran out the north door on 1 HP.

bullets.label: Scouting
bullets.text: the goblin's Stealth 17 beat his passive Perception, hidden in the dark past the lamp. The answer was a lit torch thrown into the room: on an open floor in torchlight there was nowhere left for it to hide.

bullets.label: Cheese
bullets.text: Sleep held and it failed the first save by 1, but it made the second save, so it woke before he could close for a point-blank Shocking Grasp.

bullets.label: The dice
bullets.text: Magic Missile fizzled on a 3 and is lost until a Long Rest. The goblin's second arrow hit for 8 piercing dmg. Scorching Ray burned it down to 1 HP, but two of the three rays missed.

bullets.label: How it ended
bullets.text: it failed its morale roll and fled north, out of sight. A goblin that flees counts as bypassed (the table's ruling), so the XP is his, but it is still somewhere ahead of him on 1 HP.

bullets.label: Result
bullets.text: 12/20 HP, Magic Missile lost. XP 950 → 1,000. +5 GP from the room (10 GP on him now). He gets the torch back, still burning.

trace.text: Goblin Stealth 17 beats his passive Perception 13: unseen in the dark past the lamp's 9 sq.

From the archway he lights a torch (bonus action, tinderbox) and throws it 8 sq into the room: bright light to 6 m around it, the rest dim. Room 1.2, 15×18 m (A–J × 1–12), an open empty floor; Morten at E12, the Goblin at H2, 10 sq (15 m).
Shortbow vs AC 15: miss. Nimble Escape can't hide it in torchlight on an open floor.
Sleep on the Goblin (15 m, in range 18 m): the cast holds. Concentration.
WIS save vs DC 13: fail, Incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
R2 The Goblin's second WIS save: 18 vs DC 13, success. Sleep ends on it, and it is up again at the end of its turn.
R2 Magic Missile: 8 vs DC 11, FIZZLE. Lost until a Long Rest (his habits keep Heroic Inspiration for Shield, Misty Step, Scorching Ray, Thunderwave and Sleep).
R3 Shortbow: 20 vs AC 15, hit, 8 piercing dmg. Shield would only make it AC 20, still a hit, so he keeps his reaction. Morten 20 → 12 HP.
R3 Scorching Ray, ray 1 is the casting check: 20 vs DC 12, cast, and vs AC 15, hit: 9 fire dmg. Goblin 10 → 1 HP.
R3 Rays 2 and 3 miss (12 and 9 vs AC 15).
Morale, WIS save vs DC 10: 5, fail. The Goblin flees.
Nimble Escape (Disengage) and 6 sq north through the door at E1, out of sight and out of the torchlight.

foes.name: Goblin Warrior
attacks: Shortbow +4, 16/64 sq (24/96 m), 1d6+2 piercing (+1d4 with Advantage)
foes.notes: Nimble Escape: Disengage or Hide as a bonus action; Stealth +6; darkvision 18 m

fight.verdict: a cheap win that wasn't cheap
